title: Brackets wouldn’t stay on the wall - not kid friendly
text:
Brackets wouldn’t stay on the wall - not kid friendly. The instructions for installing this rod are very straightforward. You put up the brackets by hanging them from a screw and then tightening the bracket and screw. The issue is I could never get the screw tight enough that the bracket didn’t just lift right off the screw. I kind of assumed it might be okay as long as I didn’t push up on the rod, but the thing fell off so many times as I tried to install the curtains that I didn’t feel comfortable leaving it in a room with a toddler. These were returned. I will say they had a traditional curtain hook for the middle and maybe that would have held the whole thing in place, but I didn’t want to chance it.

The angle design to allow curtains to be flush against the wall seems nice. I compensated by using a straight rod installed past the window frame.

Finally, the color is okay. It’s supposed to be like a brushed silver and I found it to be a little odd - I guess it might be described as Pewter.

description: The Eclipse 5/8" Room Darkening Wrap Around Curtain Rod is designed to wrap around your window frame to block window sidelight, reduce outside noise and drafts, and enhance privacy in your home.

The silver finished steel telescoping rod adjusts from 86 inches to 120 inches in length to fit your window and projects 3.125 inches from the wall. Use in your kitchen, bedroom, dining room, and living room to hang light to medium weight curtains. It is ideal for hanging curtains with grommets, back tabs, or pockets, but can also be used with tab tops or clip rings. The oval-shaped plastic brackets install easily and conceal the mounting screws and hardware.
Pair with Eclipse Light Filtering, Room Darkening, or Black Out curtain panels (sold separately) to maximize privacy, light blocking and noise reduction features.
Room Darkening Rod Set Includes: one telescoping steel curtain rod, two plastic mounting brackets, one center support, screws, drywall anchors, and installation instructions.
